meta.bootstrap: firm-cluster; firms drawn from E1; each estimand on its own rows of the drawn firms; one generator per block
meta.intervals: ci90/ci95 percentile; *_basic; *_normal (bootstrap se); ci90_bc bias-corrected percentile; p-values two-sided
meta.primary_slope: Psi_chi (dominance cone), chi = 0.90, window 0-60%: statistic cone_{op,cash}_slope_c90_w60 (D-2)
meta.baseline_estimand: E1 (D-3); model-facing statistics under E1, E2, E2imp4, E2imp8

variants.E2add: E2 with ambiguous pro forma cases read additively (ASC 805 reading; lower bound on organic growth)
variants.E2max: E2 with ambiguous pro forma cases read cumulatively (upper bound on organic growth)
variants.E1k2010: E1 plus fiscal-2010 years first reported only in a later filing
variants.E2k2010: E2 plus fiscal-2010 years first reported only in a later filing
variants.E1clean: E1 without the firms the review panels named as not software (rule R2 not applicable locally)
variants.E2clean: E2 without the firms the review panels named as not software (rule R2 not applicable locally)
variants.E1nodebt: E1 without the debt-only filers named by the finance referee (rule R5 not applicable locally)
variants.E2nodebt: E2 without the debt-only filers named by the finance referee (rule R5 not applicable locally)
variants.E1r2both: E1 without the firms both of two independent readers class as not software (R2 sensitivity)
variants.E2r2both: E2 without the firms both of two independent readers class as not software (R2 sensitivity)
variants.E1r2either: E1 without the firms either of two independent readers class as not software (R2 sensitivity)
variants.E2r2either: E2 without the firms either of two independent readers class as not software (R2 sensitivity)
variants.E1r2named: E1 without the named firms the R2 classifier classes non-software (equals E1 since R2 applies to the main sample)
variants.E2r2named: E2 without the named firms the R2 classifier classes non-software (equals E2 since R2 applies to the main sample)
variants.E1nolist: E1 without the firm-years rule R5 flags as no listed equity
variants.E2nolist: E2 without the firm-years rule R5 flags as no listed equity
variants.E2imp4: E2 plus the dropped acquisition-affected firm-years, organic growth imputed at a price-to-revenue multiple of 4
variants.E2imp8: E2 plus the dropped acquisition-affected firm-years, organic growth imputed at a price-to-revenue multiple of 8
variants.E2testrule: E2 under the first test run's rule (additive formula on every firm-year with disclosures, no ambiguity rule)
variants.E1all: E1 (same frame); used for the anchor with acquisition-affected firm-years kept in the tail, against the calibration rule that drops them

meta.capint: split at the period median of the sort variable inside each draw; missing intensity not classified
meta.bridge: B5: R_cash_pre = g + (FCF - SBC + interest paid + income taxes paid) / revenue; R_cash_bi = g + (FCF - SBC + interest paid x (1 - t)) / revenue, t = 35% (fiscal years ending before 2018) or 21%; cash_bs = the cash score on the firm-years where the bridge is defined; interest and taxes from SEC frames (latest filed, not first reported); InterestPaidNet and IncomeTaxesPaidNet preferred; a missing element is zero when any is reported
meta.sec_inputs: data/v3_inputs/ (retrieved 29 Oct 2026 with the author's approval; provenance in data/v3_inputs/README_retrieval.md)
meta.units: fractions (0.01 = one point) except slopes, the spend ratio, weights and regression coefficients; size gradients per tenfold revenue

families.method: Holm step-down (primary) on two-sided p-values from each statistic's own draws, three types (normal: bootstrap standard error; percentile; basic); Romano-Wolf studentized step-down on the joint draw (block joint) as a check. A contrast without an interval enters with p = 1.
